parsed.reason: This message violates multiple core rules for the "introduction" moment. It contains emoji and exclamation marks (hype); it names and describes the other household as "a family near you with a toddler" (invented specifics about the other family); it asks more than one question ("what is your name?" and "can you send your email"); it sets a deadline ("within 2 days"); it includes a link (www.example.com); and it provides an example address format (sam@example.com). The only correct element is that it asks for the name. The message reads like a company collecting contact details rather than simply asking the small thing needed to make an introduction between two existing families.
